newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge rejects government CVRD appeal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge rejects government CVRD appeal.

text.p: A federal judge in Sao Paulo on Monday rejected a government appeal against an injunction granted last week that suspends the April 29 auction of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a spokesman said.

The spokesman said the government could still appeal to a higher court. Government lawyers would contest the ruling, said a spokesman for Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), which is overseeing the CVRD privatization process.
The injuction had been granted last Friday by Judge Joao Batista Goncalves after a request by a group of individuals led by a Sao Paulo university law professor.
Meanwhile, another injunction was granted by a Rio de Janeiro judge against the CVRD auction.
